hero.headline: A Stable Framework for Power Generation
hero.subheadline: We operate under Kenya's progressive energy laws, ensuring long-term security for our captive power generation and AI operations.

sections.title: Navigating the Kenyan Energy Sector
sections.body: Kenya's energy sector is governed by the Energy Act of 2019, which encourages private investment in generation and distribution. Our project utilizes the 'Captive Power' provision, allowing us to generate electricity primarily for our own consumption. This regulatory path is highly efficient for data centers, as it reduces dependency on the national utility (Kenya Power) while allowing for potential grid-export in future phases. We maintain full compliance with the Energy and Petroleum Regulatory Authority (EPRA), securing all necessary licenses for construction and operation. This legal clarity ensures that our $0.04/kWh energy cost is not just a technical achievement, but a legally protected competitive advantage that provides certainty to our international investors.

hero.headline: The Mathematics of Protocol Yield
hero.subheadline: We bridge the gap between physical hardware and digital tokenomics, maximizing the IRR of our compute assets through DePIN.

sections.title: A New Yield Asset Class
sections.body: DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks) introduces a revolutionary revenue model for data centers. Instead of fixed monthly contracts, our revenue is a dynamic function of network tasks, uptime incentives, and protocol token appreciation. For the Kenya AI Compute project, DePIN serves as a 'High-Frequency Revenue Layer.' When a GPU is not rented by a private enterprise client, it automatically switches to performing tasks for networks like Render or io.net. This ensures that our 1MW capacity maintains nearly 100% 'utility' load, even if the 'commercial' utilization is lower. We carefully manage our token treasury, converting protocol rewards into stablecoins or USD to secure our OPEX, while retaining a portion for long-term appreciation. This dual-revenue approach—fiat and token—provides our investors with a unique risk-reward profile that outperforms traditional real estate infrastructure.

sections.title: DePIN Revenue Logic
items: Uptime Rewards: Consistent base earnings for providing certified hardware to the network.
Task Fees: Variable revenue from actual compute jobs (Rendering, Training).
Multiplier Bonuses: Higher rewards for low-latency and high-bandwidth connectivity.
Treasury Management: Strategic hedging of protocol tokens (RNDR, AKT, etc.) into USD.
Liquidity: Instant cash flow from protocol payouts with zero accounts receivable delay.

This phase is not just a test; it is a fully operational, high-yield infrastructure asset that establishes our technical standard for the 1MW expansion.

meta.title: Grid Integration & Power Redundancy | Kenya AI Compute
meta.description: How our facility interacts with the Kenyan national grid. N+1 backup strategy and power failover protocols.

hero.headline: Redundant by Nature, Stable by Design
hero.subheadline: While we generate our own power, our integration with the national grid provides a critical third layer of energy security.

sections.title: The Triple-Layer Power Strategy
sections.body: Uptime in the AI world is non-negotiable. To ensure 99.9% availability, Kenya AI Compute utilizes a 'Triple-Layer' power strategy. Layer 1 is our primary captive hybrid power plant, providing 1MW+ of direct power at $0.04/kWh. Layer 2 is our industrial UPS and high-density battery arrays, capable of supporting the full IT load during generation transitions. Layer 3 is our strategic connection to the Kenyan national grid (Kenya Power). This connection acts as a giant 'safety net' and secondary N+1 source. In the event of primary generation maintenance, the facility can seamlessly switch to the grid, ensuring that client GPUs never lose power. This integration also allows us to explore future grid-export opportunities, contributing to Kenya's energy stability while diversifying our project's revenue streams.

sections.title: Backup & Redundancy Specs
items: Failover: Automated transition between captive, UPS, and grid sources.
Grid Access: Dedicated substation for high-reliability industrial feed.
Diesel Buffer: On-site storage for 48+ hours of full-load operation.
Maintenance: Ability to service primary generators with zero IT downtime.
Stability: Advanced power conditioning at every stage to prevent GPU surges.
